correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim: cover complements are independent, hence single-shore sets or one deleted pair. A pair of omitted unmatched vertices in one shore makes two edges at a common selected neighbor indistinguishable; one omitted matched endpoint instead supplies its selected partner as a distance-2 vs distance-1 witness. A mixed pair gives distinct selected-endpoint intersections. Maximal complements give M, with the N−t exponent distinct from the two others when just one shore is saturated, since then t≥3. At t=1 the cross-pair and one-shore exponents coincide. This proves both polynomials, the minimum multiplicities and the corrected size classification. An independent BFS-and-witness replay checked 199 graphs with shores 3 through 8, 14,171 admissible masks and 1,850 maximal omissions; no submitted code was run.
